title: Evolution Under Fire: Evolving Agent Safety Harnesses with Adaptive Injection Stressors
abstract: arXiv:2611.22583v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents must act on information from untrusted emails, webpages, and documents. This creates a central security challenge: malicious instructions and legitimate task directives can arrive through the same interaction channel. Existing defenses are largely hand-designed and static, making further improvements dependent on repeated manual redesign. We introduce Evolution Under Fire, a staged framework that couples safety-harness evolution with adaptive stressor evolution. Utility-constrained, Pareto-scheduled tree search evolves complete executable safety harnesses from execution evidence while keeping the task model, benchmark, tools, and evaluator fixed. Adaptive stressor evolution then discovers utility-preserving attacks that guide a subsequent stage of harness evolution. translated_title: 火中进化：利用自适应注入压力源演化智能体安全防护机制
translated_abstract: 使用工具的语言模型智能体必须基于来自不可信电子邮件、网页和文档的信息采取行动。这带来了一个核心安全挑战：恶意指令与合法任务指令可能通过同一交互渠道到达。现有防御大多为手工设计且静态不变，使得进一步的改进依赖于反复的人工重新设计。我们提出了 Evolution Under Fire（火中进化），这是一个分阶段框架，将安全防护机制的演化与自适应压力源的演化相耦合。在保持任务模型、基准、工具和评估器固定不变的前提下，采用效用约束、按帕累托前沿调度的树搜索，从执行证据中演化出完整可执行的安全防护机制。随后，自适应压力源演化会发现保持效用的攻击，用以指导后续阶段的防护机制演化。在基于 GPT-4o-mini 的 AgentDyn 上，演化出的防护机制将攻击成功率从 50.4% 降至 3.0%，并在干净和受攻击场景下均提升了效用。
tldr: 该论文提出分阶段框架 Evolution Under Fire，通过让安全防护机制与自适应注入攻击压力源相互对抗演化，自动生成可执行的安全防护，在 AgentDyn 基准上将攻击成功率从 50.4% 降至 3.0% 且不牺牲任务效用。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Evolution Under Fire, a staged framework that couples safety-harness evolution with adaptive injection stressor evolution, automatically evolving executable safety harnesses that cut attack success from 50.4% to 3.0% on AgentDyn while preserving task utility.
